canvases.description: Track documentation PRs, release TPIs, issues, and media tasks with approved background-agent workflows.

actions.name: queue-summary
actions.description: Read queue counts, refresh errors, milestone, and local work status without fetching GitHub.

actions.name: refresh-queues
actions.description: Refresh GitHub queues, preserving cached data and reporting any individual queue errors.

actions.name: inspect-item
actions.description: Read the current source, comments, and stored workflow history for a work item.

actions.name: start-workflow
actions.description: Start a host-approved background review, documentation plan, approved implementation, or media task.

actions.name: sync-tasks
actions.description: Read actual host background-agent states and save their results.

actions.name: attach-media
actions.description: Attach a genuine PNG, WebM, or MP4 from the task private media directory for human visual review.

canvases.description: Check articles or folders and review a persistent, filterable findings inbox with private evidence-bound decisions.

actions.name: status
actions.description: Load the private findings inbox and coverage, incorporating validated confirmed results without making review decisions.

actions.name: inspect-report
actions.description: Inspect an owned execution receipt and report bundle without making review decisions. Use status for current evidence freshness.
